items.description: A coastal town located in the North Al Batinah Governorate of Oman. It is known for its traditional market and historic fort.
A coastal city in the Dhofar Governorate, known for its scenic views and historical significance near Salalah. It serves as a gateway to the Eastern Dhofar region.
A popular family-oriented public park in Muscat featuring green spaces and play areas. It is a common destination for recreation during cooler months.
A picturesque park located along the Corniche in Muscat, offering views of the harbour and the iconic incense burner monument.
A coastal park situated near the Mutrah Corniche, popular for its walkways and proximity to the ocean. It is a frequent spot for evening walks.
An indoor snow and ice park located in Mall of Oman, offering a unique sub-zero environment in the desert climate.
A water park located in Salalah, featuring various slides and swimming areas for visitors. It is a major recreational facility in the Hawana Salalah complex.
